entry.name: jit.rgb2hsl
entry.description: jit.hsl2rgb converts a 4 plane matrix of ARGB (alpha, red, green, blue) data to AHSL (alpha, hue, saturation, lightness) data. An offset and a scaling factor can be applied to the hue, saturation, and lightness data individually.
